campi_del_mandato.environmental_conditions: Experimental temperature range per condition (18-31 degC)
campi_del_mandato.instrument: AER PLUS (Algade) calibrated at the INGV radon chamber for the absolute-humidity effect; RAD7 (Durridge) in Sniff mode
campi_del_mandato.licence: CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 (verified on the PDF, p.71)
campi_del_mandato.missing_values: Rn-220 is 'bdl' in three of the six conditions, as published.
campi_del_mandato.sampling_frequency: Continuous to equilibrium; equilibrium values tabulated
campi_del_mandato.site: Scale model room built of Tufo di Gallese blocks: 62x50x35 cm internal, volume about 0.110 m3, exhaling wall surface 0.78 m2

soil_properties.motivo: no soil: the source is the wall material

campi_del_mandato.split: Validation of the indoor source term, with a declared limit: the sealed configurations sit a factor about 2 above the prediction from the published E, because sealing the outer face redirects the outgoing flux inwards. Under the 2E scenario the discrepancy is -4.3% on test 2.
campi_del_mandato.timestamp: Lucchetti et al. 2020, six experimental conditions

note: Test 1 (bare pervious walls) and test 5b are not comparable to a sealed-wall prediction and are used only for the leakage estimate.
